messages:
tess: dropped a tiny prototype for allocation breakpoints on the rollout timeline -> https://figma.com/file/abcd. idea: show vertical ticks where traffic % changes happen, hover to reveal exact allocation and a tiny diff preview.
omar: neat. how do ticks behave for overlapping canaries? can they stack or do we compress?
tess: compress slightly and add a stacked indicator with a +n hover to expand. want to avoid clutter at high-density times.
kevin: keyboard scrubbing needs to work here. if i tab into the timeline, arrow keys should move between ticks; left/right should step allocations.
maria: agree. SR: when a tick gains focus, aria-live should read: "12:07  v2.3 -> v2.4: traffic shifts 10% -> 40% for cohort: mobile-web". also include an explicit "View details" button for screen reader users.
a11y-bot: accessibility checklist: ensure 4.5:1 contrast for tick color on background, provide non-color shapes for canary vs baseline, and test with NVDA for focus order.
omar: microcopy nit: the hover preview says "allocation" which confused PMs. change to "traffic allocation" or show a percent sign.
tess: changed to "traffic allocation: 40%" in tooltip. also added mini diff strip showing before/after colored bars.
kevin: rollback affordance question: should clicking a tick offer both "Promote" and "Rollback"? feels odd to mix. maybe separate action menu: action -> Promote / Rollback / Inspect.
maria: separate action menu is clearer. also for rollback require a confirm modal with reason and an optional announce to teams. modal must be aria-modal and trap focus.
tess: good call. modal will show a timeline preview and a checkbox "Notify channel: #deploys". default unchecked.
kevin: state copy: change modal primary from "Confirm" to "Confirm and rollback traffic" per previous threads. add a small caption about required permissions if workspace is prod.
a11y-bot: extra: ensure the undo banner after rollback is keyboard dismissible and announced: "Rollback completed. Undo available for 5 minutes." 
omar: tiny ux ask: add an ephemeral hover target that's at least 44px tall for touch devices so it's not fiddly.
tess: will update the figma: stacked ticks, +n expand, keyboard scrubbing, aria-live copy, action menu, modal with confirm copy and notify checkbox, undo banner, touch target tweak, contrast/pattern updates. posting new link in ~1hr.
maria: please add a short handing checklist in the figma comments including focus order, aria labels, and test scenarios for rollbacks and promotions.
tess: will include checklist and unit tests for keyboard scrubbing behaviors. leaving thread open for last nits.
thread_summary: Design thread on adding allocation breakpoints (vertical ticks) to rollout timeline, handling dense canaries with stacked +n, keyboard scrubbing, aria-live announcements, action menu for Promote/Rollback, confirm modal and undo banner, microcopy tweaks, touch target and contrast/accessibility checklist.
